an4.18:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four ways of not taking a wrong course.
an4.18:1.3: One does not take a wrong course because of desire, because of hatred, because of delusion, or because of fear.
an4.18:1.4: These are the four ways of not taking a wrong course.”
an4.18:2.1:
If one does not transgress the Dhamma
through desire, hate, fear, or delusion,
an4.18:2.4:
like the moon
in the bright fortnight.
